about: Distance priors for planning a search when a missing person may have been taken (abduction / foul play). Each entry is one published statistic, drawn as a ring around the point it is measured from. An entry with verified=false has NOT been checked against the printed report page; check it and set verified=true with the page number before relying on it.

entries.measures_to: initial contact site (where the offender first approached the victim)
entries.printed: within 1/4 mile of the victim's last known location in 80% of cases
entries.source: Washington State Attorney General's Office child abduction murder research (Keppel et al.)
entries.verification_note: Figure taken from a web-search excerpt on 2026-10-17; the PDF host was not reachable from the build machine.
